jobs.title: Estágio de Dados (Comunicação)
jobs.description:
A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. Além da nossa atuação pelo Brasil, com escritório no Rio de janeiro, São Paulo e Belo Horizonte, temos também filiais nos Estados Unidos, fazendo com que a Radix se consolide cada vez mais como uma empresa **global**.

  

Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade?

  

Como Estagiário(a) de Dados, você vai:

* Extrair, organizar e analisar dados de performance de comunicações em diferentes canais.

* Criar e atualizar dashboards para acompanhar métricas, identificar tendências e apoiar a tomada de decisões.

* Apoiar a interpretação dos resultados das comunicações e a identificação de oportunidades de melhoria.

* Contribuir para a segmentação de audiências com base em dados, visando aumentar o alcance e a efetividade das comunicações.

* Apoiar a definição e o acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho.

Para essa vaga, você deve ter:

* Estar cursando Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

* Conhecimentos básicos de análise e visualização de dados.

* Conhecimentos em Excel ou ferramentas similares.

* Inglês intermediário, especialmente para leitura e comunicação no ambiente de trabalho.

* Perfil analítico, organizado, curioso e atenção aos detalhes.

É um diferencial se você tiver:

* Conhecimentos em Power BI ou outras ferramentas de criação de dashboards.

* Conhecimentos em SQL, Python ou outra linguagem de programação voltada à análise de dados.

* Interesse por comunicação corporativa, transformação digital e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

**Benefícios:**

* Assistência Médica Nacional (para o titular e dependentes, com quarto privativo)
* Assistência odontológica nacional (para o titular e dependentes)
* Vale refeição / alimentação flexível
* Auxílio Home office
* Day off (no mês do aniversário)
* Wellhub (antigo Gympass)
* Parceria de apoio em saúde mental com a Wellz
* Clube de Vantagens com descontos em diversos parceiros
* Convênio com instituições de ensino e cursos de idioma
* Desenvolvimento Profissional (Universidade Corporativa)
* Parceria com empresa de coworkings no Brasil
* Programa de Qualidade de Vida e Bem-Estar Médico consultor

  

**A Radix está sempre no topo das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar porque:**

* Temos profissionais comprometidos, dedicados, curiosos e inovadores.
* O espírito de equipe é a nossa maior força. Trabalhamos de forma cooperativa e sabemos que estamos juntos, remando na mesma direção.
* Temos um ambiente diverso, que valoriza equidade e inclusão.
* Nossa jornada de trabalho é flexível e em quase todos os projetos é possível trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
* Valorizamos o bem-estar e o cuidado com as nossas pessoas, com programas de apoio à saúde mental, psiquiatra e médico consultor disponíveis.

**Curtiu?**

  

**#VemPraRadix**

Código da Vaga: 6b8e
reasons: skills: python, sql, power bi, excel, análise de dados, estatística (+18)

Noções de RAG: embeddings, vector DBs (pgvector, Chroma, Qdrant) e busca híbrida. Noções de MCP (Model Context Protocol). Familiaridade com Docker. Noções de uma cloud (Azure / AWS / GC). Você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade. Você gostaria de moldar seu futuro com confiança? jobs.title: Assistente de Dados (LAVINIA SOUZA QUEIROZ)

Uso de ferramentas de IA no dia a dia, como Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT ou similares.

Experiência prática com Databricks.
Noções de PySpark.
Experiência com Claude Code.
Experiência usando IA para coletar ou tratar dados.

Somos uma empresa global de tecnologia orientada por inteligência artificial (AI-first), com mais de 25 anos de liderança em engenharia de software, mais de 2.000 profissionais e mais de 500 projetos ativos que impulsionam clientes da Fortune 500, incluindo Microsoft, Google, HBO e Starbucks. * Demonstrar interesse em aprender novas tecnologias, ferramentas e metodologias de desenvolvimento.

* Conhecimento básico em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação, preferencialmente Java ou Python.
* Familiaridade com JavaScript e conceitos fundamentais de desenvolvimento web.
* Conhecimento básico de bancos de dados relacionais e linguagem SQL, preferencialmente MySQL.

jobs.title: AI Engineer BizTech - Vendas Parceiros
jobs.description:
O BizTech AI é o núcleo de tecnologia para o negócio da Conta Azul. Ele existe para dar às áreas autonomia e velocidade para usar tecnologia e IA, sem perder visão corporativa, segurança e ganho de escala.

Como IA Engineer, você vai atuar embarcado(a) em Vendas Parceiros, ao lado do Product Builder e dos Salesforce Engineers. Sua missão é colocar IA e automações em produção, com segurança e dentro da política corporativa. O Product Builder define o porquê e o o quê. Você é dono(a) do como na implementação: pega o que foi validado com a área e transforma em soluções robustas, integradas aos sistemas da operação comercial (como Salesforce e sistemas corporativos) e fáceis de manter.

**SOBRE A CONTA AZUL**

A Conta Azul é movida pela crença que todo empreendedor merece ter sucesso. Apesar do dia a dia cheio de responsabilidades, queremos que todo dono de um pequeno negócio consiga tempo para se dedicar ao que sempre sonhou quando decidiu abrir uma empresa. Por isso, usamos a tecnologia para criar uma plataforma em nuvem, onde o empreendedor juntamente com o seu contador, de forma simples e fácil, podem encontrar tudo o que precisam em tempo real. Buscamos pessoas motivadas neste propósito. Se você é esta pessoa, junte-se a nós!

**Responsabilidades e atribuições**

* Do protótipo à produção: transformar os protótipos e casos de uso validados pelo Product Builder em soluções de produção escaláveis, seguras e de fácil manutenção, seguindo os padrões de arquitetura e dados do núcleo.
* IA e automação na operação comercial: construir e manter agentes, automações e integrações com IA que reduzam o trabalho manual e deem velocidade às frentes de Aquisição, Ativação e Gestão de Parceiros.
* Integração entre sistemas: conectar Salesforce, sistemas corporativos e ferramentas da área por meio de APIs, webhooks e filas, para que os dados circulem sem retrabalho e com uma única fonte confiável.
* Co-autoria técnica do PRD: contribuir com a parte técnica das especificações: estimativas, riscos, dependências e critérios de aceite verificáveis. Questionar ambiguidades com o PB antes de implementar.
* Qualidade desde o desenvolvimento: escrever testes automatizados, fazer code review e documentar as soluções. Manter avaliações das soluções de IA (conjuntos de referência e testes de regressão) para perceber quando uma mudança de prompt ou de modelo quebra algo.
* Operação e evolução contínua: monitorar as soluções em produção (latência, custo de uso dos modelos, taxa de erro), corrigir falhas, atuar em incidentes e propor melhorias com base em dados reais.
* Segurança e governança de IA: aplicar a política corporativa de uso de IA. Validar o que entra no modelo, filtrar o que sai dele e limitar as permissões dos agentes ao mínimo necessário. Usar as ferramentas do catálogo aprovado e participar da guilda técnica.

**Requisitos e qualificações**

**NECESSÁRIOS**

* Base sólida em desenvolvimento de software: experiência construindo e mantendo soluções em produção, com conhecimento profundo em pelo menos uma linguagem (como Python, Java, TypeScript/Node ou Go). Clean code, design patterns e testes automatizados fazem parte da sua rotina.
* Implementação prática de IA: experiência real integrando LLMs a sistemas existentes, via APIs de modelos (como Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock) ou orquestradores (como LangChain, n8n). Não é pesquisa, é entrega.
* Integração de APIs e dados: domínio de REST, webhooks e filas, e capacidade de integrar sistemas diferentes. SQL para consultar e preparar dados.
* Context engineering: saber escrever e versionar as instruções, os dados e as ferramentas que definem como o modelo pensa e age.
* Uso avançado de IA no dia a dia: usar assistentes de desenvolvimento (como Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) e conseguir mostrar na prática como a IA acelera seu trabalho de desenvolvimento, análise e resolução de problemas.
* Mentalidade de produto: entender o contexto de negócio do que constrói, questionar quando algo não faz sentido e medir sucesso pelo valor entregue, não só pela funcionalidade.
* Comunicação e colaboração: explicar decisões técnicas para pessoas não técnicas sem jargão e trabalhar bem em times enxutos e multidisciplinares.

**DESEJÁVEIS**

* Experiência com desenvolvimento no Salesforce (Apex, Flows, integrações) ou com outras plataformas de CRM.
* Conhecimento de segurança aplicada a IA (prompt injection, controle de permissões de agentes).
* Experiência com AWS, containers (Docker) e pipelines de CI/CD.
* Vivência com sistemas de operação comercial, ERP ou sistemas corporativos.

**Informações adicionais:**

**BENEFÍCIOS**

* **Plano de saúde:** cobertura nacional sem custo de mensalidade ou coparticipação. Pode ser estendido a dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), conforme política interna.
* **Plano odontológico:** cobertura nacional sem custo de mensalidade. Pode se estender aos dependentes (filhos e cônjuges) conforme política interna.
* **Benefício flexível**: R$ 1.000,00 por mês para investir em educação (70% de reembolso em mensalidades), idiomas (70%), atividades físicas e atendimento com psicólogos(as), nutricionistas, massoterapeutas e fisioterapeutas (50%).
* **Auxílio creche** para Papais e Mamães com filhos entre 0 e 24 meses.
* **Auxílio Home Office mensal -** Apoio mensal a partir de R$ 150,00 (de acordo com a localidade)
* **Auxílio Home Office** - parcela única para custear a estação de trabalho.

* **Zenklub**: acesso ilimitado a psicólogos, terapeutas, coaches e psicanalistas. As duas primeiras sessões do mês são gratuitas, e as demais têm custo de apenas R$ 20,00.
* **Programa de bônus** conforme atingimento de metas.
* **Benefício Farmácia**: App Vidalink com subsídio de 75% para medicamentos com receita. Podendo se estender aos dependentes (filhos e cônjuges) conforme política interna.
* **Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas**.
* **Filiação gratuita ao Sesc**: podendo estender os benefícios aos dependentes. A filiação garante acesso a diversas atividades e serviços com preços especiais, como educação, esportes, lazer, excursões, hotéis, programação cultural, assistência odontológica e nutrição. Você paga apenas pelas atividades que utilizar.

* **GoGood**: Acesso a diversas academias em todo o Brasil com subsídio de 50% para Azuis. Dependentes podem aderir ao plano integral.
* **Auxílio Mudança**: Para todos os Azuis que têm o desejo de estar mais próximo da sede, oferecemos uma ajuda de custo para apoiar neste processo.

Pacote de Experiências:

* **Baby Blue Time**: jornada menor de trabalho com flexibilidade extra de horário nos retornos das licenças Maternidade e Paternidade;
* **Days Off Experience**: Todos os Azuis com mais de 1 ano de casa poderão ter 4 folgas no ano;
* **Sabático Parcialmente Remunerad**o: período em que os Azuis elegíveis podem ficar off e ainda recebem uma graninha antecipadamente;

E mais:

* Ambiente inovador que proporciona crescimento, com profissionais incríveis e de aprendizado constante;
* Escritório com acessibilidade, que estimula a criatividade e produtividade, com comida e bebida à vontade;
* Horário flexível (trabalhamos de segunda a sexta).

  

**Diversidade & Inclusão na Conta Azul**

Na Conta Azul, prezamos por um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas se sintam respeitadas, valorizando as diferentes vivências e as particularidades de cada Azul. Por isso, promovemos a diversidade em nossos processos seletivos, como um reflexo da nossa crença na integração e na valorização de cada pessoa.

Fique à vontade para declarar as informações no formulário de inscrição. Esses dados são essenciais para promover um processo seletivo inclusivo, e serão utilizados exclusivamente para essa finalidade, sem qualquer impacto durante ou após o processo.

Investigar problemas, propor soluções e pedir apoio quando necessário. Comunicação clara. Explicar decisões técnicas em linguagem acessível e sinalizar impedimentos cedo. Pensamento analítico. Testar hipóteses e priorizar melhorias com base em evidências. Atenção aos detalhes e responsabilidade. Verificar o impacto das mudanças em produção, especialmente sobre acessos e dados. Escuta e foco em quem usa. Entender as dificuldades dos usuários e propor fluxos mais simples. Abertura a feedback. Incorporar contribuições do time nas revisões de código. **SOBRE A VAGA**

Você vai construir e operar os agentes de IA que atendem, vendem e resolvem para as marcas que são nossas clientes, do desenho da arquitetura multi-agente até o que roda em produção conversando com o consumidor final.

jobs.title: [Job-32733] Master FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer) - React / .NET, Brazil
jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

**About the role**
------------------

CI&T is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed with a global enterprise client and ship AI-powered features into its React and .NET operator portal. You will own outcomes end to end: from the first workshop with the client's architects to the code running in production.

A Forward Deployed Engineer is a software engineer first and a consultant second. You work directly with client stakeholders to understand a messy, ambiguous problem, shape the solution, write the production code, and stay until it is adopted. This is not a pre-sales or project management role: you build.

The first mission is to integrate an existing AI assistant into the client's operator portal as a micro frontend, so it runs both inside the portal and as a standalone app. The portal serves frontline and site management teams at large scale.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Discover with the client.** Run working sessions with the client's architects, product owners and frontline users to map workflows, constraints and the highest-value problems.
* **Build and ship production code.** Design and deliver micro frontends in React and TypeScript, and the .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) services and APIs behind them.
* **Own the integration contract.** Define how the AI assistant plugs into the host portal: module loading, shared state, routing, user and site context, and versioning, so both sides can deploy independently.
* **Handle identity and security.** Implement single sign-on across identity providers (for example Entra ID and OneLogin), with role-based access and secure token handling.
* **Make it production-ready.** Set up telemetry, accessibility, responsive UX, CI/CD and automated tests, and take part in production deployment and hypercare.
* **Prototype fast.** Turn open questions into working prototypes in days, so the client decides on evidence rather than slides.
* **Close the loop.** Feed what you learn in the field back into the solution and into CI&T's reusable assets, and help shape the next phases of scope.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of professional software engineering, with code you shipped to production and supported.
* Strong React and TypeScript, including state management, performance and component architecture in large applications.
* Hands-on micro frontend experience in production (for example Module Federation or single-spa), or a clear account of how you split and integrated a large front end.
* Solid .NET backend experience: C#, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs and integration with enterprise systems.
* Working knowledge of SSO and identity standards (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML) in enterprise environments.
* CI/CD, automated testing and cloud deployment, preferably on Azure.
* **Advanced English, spoken and written.** You will lead workshops, present trade-offs and negotiate scope directly with international stakeholders.
* Proven client-facing experience: you have worked directly with business or technical stakeholders outside your own team.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Python, especially for AI work: calling LLM APIs, building agents or RAG pipelines.
* Experience building user interfaces for AI assistants or chatbots (streaming responses, conversation history, feedback capture).
* Familiarity with agent platforms and protocols such as MCP, Copilot Studio or Agentforce.
* Exposure to Databricks or other enterprise data platforms.
* Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.
* Experience with apps used by frontline or mobile workforces, including accessibility requirements.
* Spanish or French.

**Who thrives in this role**
----------------------------

You are comfortable starting without a complete spec. You ask the questions that turn an ambiguous request into a clear plan, then you build it.

* You explain a technical trade-off to an architect and to a business user, and both leave with the same decision.
* You prefer showing a working prototype over writing a long document.
* You own the result, not just the ticket: if the feature is not adopted, you find out why.
* You care about cost and scale, because the solution serves hundreds of thousands of users.

In the first 90 days, success means the client has a working micro frontend integration in a test environment, an agreed integration contract between both teams, and a clear plan for production rollout.

**Logistics**

Essa pessoa será responsável por desenvolver soluções técnicas robustas e escaláveis, atuando em toda a stack tecnológica com autonomia, senso crítico e excelência técnica. A posição é ideal para profissionais experientes que buscam impacto direto no produto, trabalhando com tecnologias modernas e contribuindo ativamente para a evolução da arquitetura, qualidade do código e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

**Aviso importante!**

A **Conexa nunca cobra qualquer valor** para participação em seus processos seletivos. Todas as nossas vagas são divulgadas **exclusivamente pela Gupy** e o processo de inscrição é **totalmente gratuito**. Caso receba qualquer pedido de pagamento ou oferta de vaga fora da Gupy, desconfie! Isso não faz parte da nossa prática de recrutamento.

**Requisitos e qualificações**

CRIADOR(A) DE CONTEÚDO DIGITAL E PÁGINAS COM IA

- Curte vídeos, redes sociais, criatividade e tecnologia? Então essa oportunidade pode ser para você!

Estamos procurando uma pessoa criativa, que goste do universo digital e tenha vontade de trabalhar com criação de vídeos, páginas de sites e ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial (IA).

O trabalho envolve transformar ideias em conteúdos visuais, criar vídeos e desenvolver páginas para sites e projetos digitais, utilizando ferramentas modernas de IA.

Não precisa ter experiência profissional! Queremos alguém criativo, que tenha facilidade com computador, goste de vídeos, tecnologia e tenha vontade de aprender coisas novas.

- O que você vai fazer?

Criar e editar vídeos para páginas de sites e projetos digitais.

Criar, montar e personalizar páginas de sites.

Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para criação de vídeos, imagens e conteúdos.

Adaptar páginas e conteúdos conforme as necessidades dos projetos.

Explorar ideias, referências e formatos criativos.

Trabalhar com diferentes ferramentas e tecnologias do universo digital.

- O que buscamos?

Gostar de vídeos, redes sociais e criação de conteúdo.

Ter criatividade e boas ideias.

Saber utilizar computador e navegar na internet.

Ter interesse por Inteligência Artificial e novas tecnologias.

Ter facilidade para aprender a utilizar novas ferramentas.

Ter iniciativa e comprometimento com as entregas.

Será um diferencial: já ter utilizado CapCut, Canva, ferramentas de IA, editores de sites, WordPress ou ferramentas de criação de páginas e edição de vídeos.

- Condições da prestação de serviços

Remuneração mensal: R$ 2.300,00.

Modalidade: prestação de serviços PJ.

Vaga PRESENCIAL, o escritório fica no centro de Brusque.

Período de atendimento: segunda a sexta-feira, das 7h às 16h, com 1 hora de intervalo.

- Por que essa oportunidade pode ser interessante?

Uma oportunidade para quem gosta do mundo digital, quer trabalhar com Inteligência Artificial e desenvolver habilidades em criação de vídeos, páginas de sites e conteúdos digitais.

Não procuramos apenas alguém para executar tarefas, mas uma pessoa que goste de criar, experimentar, aprender e trazer ideias novas.

- Gostou da oportunidade? Entre em contato e conte um pouco sobre você! Queremos conhecer você.

Pagamento: R$2.300,00 por mês

Local do trabalho: Presencial

jobs.title: Rail BI Advisor
jobs.description:
### **Sobre a oportunidade**

A **Pantheon Inc Brasil** está contratando um(a) **Rail BI Advisor** para atuar em um cliente global do setor de Óleo e Gás.

A posição é 100% remota, com atuação em projetos de Business Intelligence voltados à área de Supply Chain, especificamente no segmento de transporte ferroviário.

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e dar suporte a dashboards em Power BI, traduzindo as necessidades do time de negócio dos Estados Unidos em soluções de dados e indicadores, em parceria com o time técnico localizado no Brasil.

Buscamos uma pessoa proativa, com senso de dono, boa comunicação e interesse em fazer parte de um time global.

### **Principais responsabilidades**

* Levantar, analisar e documentar requisitos de negócio para soluções de Analytics.
* Desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos de dados em Power BI e Sigma.
* Definir KPIs e indicadores de desempenho junto aos stakeholders.
* Realizar consultas, análises e validações de dados utilizando SQL.
* Trabalhar em parceria com engenheiros de dados e arquitetos na construção de soluções completas.
* Apresentar entregas aos stakeholders e incorporar feedback dos usuários.
* Participar de cerimônias ágeis e do refinamento do backlog.

### **Requisitos obrigatórios**

* De 3 a 5 anos de experiência em Business Intelligence.
* Conhecimento avançado em Power BI, incluindo dashboards, relatórios e modelagem de dados.
* Experiência com Snowflake e CDH.
* Conhecimento de SQL para consultas, união de bases e validação de dados.
* Experiência com levantamento de requisitos e tradução de necessidades de negócio em soluções de Analytics.
* Boa comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento com stakeholders.
* Experiência em equipes que trabalham com metodologias ágeis.
* Inglês avançado ou fluente.
* Formação técnica ou superior em TI ou áreas relacionadas, ou experiência equivalente no mercado de tecnologia.

### **Diferenciais**

* Conhecimento em Sigma Computing.
* Experiência com Supply Chain, Transporte, Logística ou operações ferroviárias.
* Conhecimento em Azure Data Platform e Azure DevOps.
* Experiência com stakeholders internacionais.
* Conhecimento em governança e qualidade de dados.
* Certificação Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300).
* Experiência no setor de Óleo e Gás.

### **Modelo de trabalho e contratação**

* **Modelo de trabalho:** 100% remoto, de qualquer cidade do Brasil.
* **Contratação:** CLT ou PJ.
* **Duração do projeto:** 12 meses.
* **Início previsto:** Dezembro de 2026.

jobs.title: Director AI Native Product Builder | New Ventures
jobs.description:
**Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.**

**GET TO KNOW US**

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

**Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!**

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **Director AI Native Product Builder** in our New Ventures area in Brazil! This is a **Remote – Brazil** position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

Wellhub serves millions of members today. The next generation of wellness experiences they are waiting for (deeper personalization, integrated journeys across fitness, longevity and emotional wellbeing) does not yet exist inside our walls. New Ventures exists to build those products, at AI speed. Small squads own each bet end-to-end, from earliest hypothesis through validation, MVP, and scale. Every prototype starts with AI, and every workflow is rebuilt around it.

You will report directly to the Founder/GM of the bet you join and lead its builders as part of a small, single-threaded squad. You own the build end-to-end, minimizing friction and rethinking traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering. You will work daily with the Founder/GM, the bet's product manager, data and design craft leads, and a fleet of AI agents. This is a player-coach role: you lead people, and you are still in the work, directing AI to ship. The methods we prove in New Ventures are the methods that will shape future bets, and your work will connect directly to Wellhub's company goals: be loved, be global, be fit.

  

**YOUR IMPACT**

* **Lead the build for your bet:** take ambiguous problems from earliest hypothesis to a production-grade MVP and into scale, end-to-end.
* **Make AI the product fabric:** embed AI as the core mechanic of the member experience, not a feature bolted on top, so the product would be impossible to recreate without it.
* **Compress cycle time:** the metric that defines us is days from member insight to shipped experiment. Ship working prototypes in days and production-grade increments in weeks, and set the pace the squad has to match.
* **Set the AI-native bar for the squad:** define the context, agents, prompts, evals, and ways of working every builder in the bet operates at, and make the bar visible by shipping above it yourself.
* **Build foundations that compound:** when a pattern (agent harness, eval framework, prompt library, shared context) is reusable, extract it and make it the default, so the next builder in New Ventures doesn't re-solve what you already shipped.
* **Lead and grow the builders in the bet:** hire, coach, and develop the team. Run the rituals that pull everyone up the AI curve (pair, demo, document, teach). Before approving a hire, show why AI couldn't do the work.
* **Own quality and safety in production:** partner with the product manager on evals and guardrails, so we know the AI is good enough before members do, and sensitive data is handled with care.
* **Stand behind kill decisions:** when an experiment or a direction doesn't pan out, say so early. Killing on time is part of how a healthy portfolio operates.
* **Bring product taste and founder mentality:** call great products great and bad products bad, make decisions with incomplete information, and move toward the unknown rather than away from it.
* **Live the mission:** care for your own wellbeing and your colleagues', and build a team where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Experience shipping consumer or B2B SaaS products, hybrid by craft: deep fluency in product craft (discovery, UX, instrumentation, iteration) and modern engineering (architecture, systems, full-stack thinking). The combination is the role.
* Shipped products to production at meaningful scale, from earliest hypothesis through validation, MVP, and scale, and comfortable killing a hypothesis that didn't pan out.
* Deep, hands-on AI fluency: you use modern AI tooling (AI-assisted IDEs, agent frameworks, LLM APIs) every day, and hold strong, evidence-backed opinions on prompts, evals, retrieval, and model selection.
* Fluent across the AI-native disciplines: context engineering as infrastructure, agentic development as your primary execution model (direct, execute, review, iterate), and vibe coding to compress build-measure-learn. You can teach all three.
* Experience leading a team of builders or engineers as a player-coach: you teach by pairing, demoing, and documenting, and you don't delegate the interesting work and review slides about it.
* Customer-centric to the core: you can name the customer problem behind every product you've shipped, in the customer's own words.
* Bias to ship, with taste: you ship Monday and iterate Tuesday, and you know which corners cannot be cut.
* Comfortable operating without a playbook: you push back when the data says so, change your mind fast when shown new evidence, and are comfortable being a beginner again on the things AI changes every month.
* Advanced English required; you'll work daily with stakeholders across BR, US, and EU.

**Nice to have:**

* Background in health, fitness, or wellbeing products.
* Experience building AI products that handle sensitive personal or health data.
* A track record of pulling a team or an organization toward a new way of working.
* Exposure to products operating across multiple countries and languages.
* Advanced Portuguese.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that deep hands-on fluency with modern AI tooling and concepts (AI-assisted development, agent frameworks, LLM APIs, evals, prompt design), a track record of shipping consumer or B2B products at scale, and advanced English are mandatory requirements.

  

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

**Our benefits include:**

**WELLHUB:** Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

**WELLZ:** A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

**HEALTHCARE:** Health, dental, and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

**FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:** Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

**PAID TIME OFF:** It's important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

**PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:** Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

**CAREER GROWTH:** Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

**CULTURE:** You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

**Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on** **Instagram** **@lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on** **YouTube****!**

**Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub**

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

**#LI-REMOTE**

jobs.title: Analista de Cibersegurança Júnior (Blue Team)
[1331] Pesquisador de IA (Híbrido - Manaus)
Product Owner, AI Pod
jobs.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical **Product Owner** (Contractor) for two AI Pods that build the foundations of Numa, Enumerate's AI product line, including Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist. This role is focused on execution, not product strategy or roadmap direction. The Product Owner will own and detail the AI Pod backlog, lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for every release, document test findings clearly, and analyze customer usage and metrics to inform what gets built next. The role reports to the Director of Product Management and works closely with Product Managers and Engineering. This is a strong fit for someone with a QA background who has recently moved into a product role and wants to grow in product management working on live, customer-facing AI products.

This is a remote contractor opportunity for candidates located in LATAM who are comfortable working in an English-speaking professional environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

Backlog Ownership & Agile Execution

* Own, detail, and manage the delivery backlog for the two AI Pod teams
* Translate defined product priorities into detailed user stories, functional requirements, and testable acceptance criteria
* Break down initiatives into well-scoped epics, stories, and tasks with clear definitions of ready and done
* Keep backlog items refined, prioritized, and ready for development ahead of each sprint
* Work with other Product Managers and Product Owners whose features depend on the AI Pods to validate requirements and sign-off
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives
* Partner with Engineering to clarify scope, remove blockers, and escalate dependencies and risks

User Acceptance Testing & Quality Validation

* Plan and conduct UAT for AI Pod deliverables and provide release sign-off
* Create and maintain UAT plans, test scenarios, and test cases tied to acceptance criteria
* Perform functional, regression, and edge-case testing on completed stories and features before release
* Validate AI output quality for Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist, including accuracy, relevance, consistency, and exception handling, using repeatable test prompts and evaluation sets
* Log, document, and prioritize defects, and verify fixes before closing

Documentation of Findings

* Document UAT results, defects, and AI output evaluation findings in a clear, structured, repeatable format
* Produce release-level test summaries covering what was tested, results, known issues, and recommended follow-ups
* Maintain up-to-date user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, and supporting documentation
* Provide Product Marketing with feature details and release information needed for go-to-market materials

Customer Usage & Metrics Analysis

* Own product analytics for Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist, including adoption, usage, and engagement metrics
* Analyze usage patterns, customer questions, and feedback to identify friction points, gaps in AI responses, and improvement opportunities
* Build and maintain recurring usage and metrics reporting for product leadership
* Turn findings into backlog items and use data to inform prioritization

AI & Automation Workflow Enablement

* Analyze and document end-to-end workflows suitable for AI-driven automation
* Turn tasks users currently perform manually into clear requirements Engineering can build from
* Define business rules, inputs, outputs, dependencies, and exception handling
* Ensure workflows are well-documented and testable

**Required Qualifications**

* Background in QA or software testing (manual and/or automated), with recent hands-on experience (roughly 1–3 years) as a Product Owner, Associate Product Manager, or Business Analyst on a software product
* Strong UAT experience: writing test plans and test cases from acceptance criteria, executing functional, regression, and edge-case testing, and giving release sign-off
* Experience writing detailed user stories and testable acceptance criteria and managing a backlog in Jira or a similar tool within an Agile/Scrum team
* At least some hands-on experience with AI products, such as working on, testing, or supporting an LLM-powered assistant, chatbot, or AI feature
* Working understanding of LLMs, including why outputs vary, common failure modes such as hallucination and inconsistency, and how to test and evaluate AI output quality
* Analytical by nature: comfortable pulling and interpreting product usage data and turning findings into clear recommendations
* Clear, structured written documentation that others can act on without a walkthrough
* Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken

**Nice to Have**

* B2B SaaS experience, ideally vertical SaaS, proptech, or FinTech/Payments
* Experience evaluating conversational AI output in a structured way (prompt test sets, evaluation rubrics, regression testing for AI)
* Experience with product analytics tools (e.g., Pendo, Mixpanel, Amplitude) and basic SQL
* Experience working with distributed engineering teams across time zones
* Familiarity with property management, HOA/community association, or accounting workflows

**About Us**

Enumerate is a leader in the property management space offering a robust ERP system called Central that delivers Community Accounting, Management, Communications, Engagement, and Reporting all on one easy-to-use platform. It is the most comprehensive solution for property management, powerful enough to support large scale Property Managers, yet easy enough for Self-Management Associations.

At Enumerate, we put the Customer First in everything we do, delivering customer-centric solutions and finding ways to say YES. We have an incredible team atmosphere where egos don't exist, and we credit others for contributions, accomplishments, and success.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (AWS, Node.js)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a talented Senior AWS/Back-end Developer with 5 years of programming background to own and evolve the cloud infrastructure and backend services behind an established healthcare and community care platform. You will be responsible for core development, production support, and security across the AWS services and APIs that connect Salesforce with a React Native mobile app. The platform handles sensitive health and personal data, so security, data protection, and reliability are central to this role.

### **JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

**Must have:**

* **5+ years of commercial experience** in backend development with AWS
* Strong programming skills in **TypeScript (Node.js)**
* **Hands-on experience with core AWS services**: Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/Fargate, RDS/DynamoDB, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Cognito
* **Experience with AWS–Salesforce integrations:** APIs, Platform Events / Change Data Capture, Named Credentials, AppFlow, or middleware
* Strong Infrastructure as Code skills with AWS CDK or CloudFormation
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and services
* Solid AWS networking knowledge: VPC design, subnets, routing, VPN/PrivateLink, DNS (Route 53)
* Experience owning production support: monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis (CloudWatch, X-Ray)
* Experience with backups, disaster recovery, and environment upgrades
* Understanding of AWS Well-Architected practices for reliability, scalability, and cost optimization
* Experience securing APIs and backend services, including authentication and OAuth flows
* Experience working with sensitive or regulated data, with a security-first mindset
* **English level: Upper intermediate or higher**

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with Terraform
* Experience supporting backends for mobile apps (React Native): auth, push notifications, file storage
* Experience in healthcare, aged care, or other regulated domains
* AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer, DevOps Engineer, Security Specialty)

**Technical stack:**

* Primary stack: TypeScript / Node.js / AWS CDK or CloudFormation
* AWS: Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/Fargate, RDS/DynamoDB, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Cognito, CloudWatch, X-Ray, Route 53
* Integrations: Salesforce (APIs, Platform Events / CDC, Named Credentials, OAuth, AppFlow), React Native mobile app

### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**AWS infrastructure (core focus):**

* Design, build, and evolve AWS infrastructure and backend services
* Own Infrastructure as Code and keep environments consistent
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and services
* Manage networking: VPC design, subnets, routing, VPN/PrivateLink, DNS
* Optimize reliability, scalability, and cost through right-sizing, autoscaling, and Well-Architected practices

**Support and operations:**

* Own production support: monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis
* Maintain backups, disaster recovery, and environment upgrades
* Write runbooks and infrastructure documentation and keep them up to date

**Salesforce and mobile integration:**

* Understand and support the integration points between AWS and Salesforce
* Troubleshoot integration issues together with the Salesforce team (configuring or developing in Salesforce is out of scope)
* Provide and secure the backend services and APIs used by the React Native mobile app: auth, API endpoints, push notifications, file storage

**PROJECT**

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Liferay**

Liferay is a uniquely profitable B2B enterprise software company with 1,000+ fiery-eyed employees all across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, Asia, and Africa. As a renowned provider of enterprise open source technologies, we have been recognized by Gartner for empowering businesses around the world to solve complex digital challenges. Liferay’s all-in-one platform unites Liferay DXP with our cloud platform capabilities, built-in analytics, and commerce functionality, reducing time to market and accelerating innovation. Our customer roster includes global companies such as Airbus, US Bank, Honda, and Desjardins.

But we don’t just make awesome software, we are also fueled by a greater-than-profit vision. By building a vibrant business, making technology useful, and investing in communities, we make it possible for people to reach their full potential to serve others. This commitment extends beyond our product; Liferay donates 10% of our profits to charities around the world. Oh, we’re also self-funded which gives us the freedom to work on whatever we think brings the most value to customers and communities in the long run!

**About You and this Role**

You enjoy solving problems and thrive in a customer-centric environment. You don’t just focus on operations but also love running systems and software in the real world. The ideal candidate will have progressively stronger experience in distributed systems, Linux/Unix design, networking, and systems and reliability engineering applied in a cloud environment. You are excited about containers, and container orchestration with Kubernetes. One of your passions is to build DevOps tools that make it easier for people to build, deploy and scale apps on our Cloud platform. As a developer in this role, you should love being able to build, ship, and run applications with ease.

This is an opportunity to join the team at a relatively early stage and help us engineer a scalable, hybrid-cloud platform based on Kubernetes to support Liferay customer systems worldwide while gaining top-notch experience in cloud computing. Our charter is to define the next generation of cloud-native infrastructure to serve as the pipeline for teams building Liferay applications to digitally transform businesses worldwide. Container technologies and platforms such as Kubernetes are literally exploding in popularity. Our team is right at the forefront of this technological shift, defining and implementing the next generation hybrid platform for containers, and we want you to join us in this exciting challenge! Apply today to be part of an exceptional team enabling Liferay's portfolio of products on the cloud.

**Key Objectives**

* Help drive the technology vision for our Cloud infrastructure;
* Conduct R&D on Cloud infrastructure technologies (e.g. k8s operators, service mesh, process automation, etc.);
* Design crash and test scenarios to improve our resiliency, performance and stability;
* Support our release process via our CI/CD tooling;
* Collaborate with other technical teams with task automation and overall devops and infrastructure best practices;
* Work on defining and implementing the next versions of our global Cloud architecture;
* Close security gaps mapped by our InfoSec and SecOps teams;
* Support technical teams in a collaborative, enabling environment;
* Monitor overall health of our ecosystem;
* Help manage upgrades and patches for systems in our Cloud ecosystem;
* Help with tickets escalated via our Cloud Customer Care and Support teams;
* Create and maintain architectural, security and other documentation as needed for each system supported;
* Provide technical support to internal teams, which include troubleshooting user operating problems, application problems, system configuration issues and malfunctions, and network connectivity and performance operating problems in a cloud environment.

**Required Qualifications**

* BS in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent experience.
* Experience running and operating Kubernetes on a public cloud.
* Experience with Docker and Terraform;
* Experience running and maintaining a 24x7 production environment.
* Experience scripting in some of the common languages used by system engineers (shell, golang).
* Experience operating large-scale distributed systems preferably using GCP.
* Knowledge of Networking, VPN, identifying and solving network issues.
* Strong communication and team player skills
* Comfortable with Agile practices for delivering iterative solutions to the business.
* Fully comfortable working in English, written and spoken. Some of your teammates will be in the Americas, Asia or Europe.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Liferay DXP, Liferay Cloud, or equivalent enterprise portal platforms.
* Experience with at least one of the following managed Kubernetes services:
  + Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
  + Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
  + Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS)
* Experience in automating development processes and environments.
* Experience implementing full CI/CD (continuous integration/continuous delivery) pipelines.
* Experience with LetsEncrypt integrated with Kubernetes
* Experience with Linux, MySQL, NGINX, Tomcat, Git, Jenkins.
* Any of the following certifications:
  + Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect
  + Google Cloud Certified Professional DevOps Engineer
  + Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Security Engineer
  + Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Network Engineer

**What We Offer**

* Salary package w/ competitive benefits according to qualifications and experience  
  Opportunities to take responsibility, grow professionally, and Stay Nerdy
* A positive and collaborative work culture
* Working at a leading open-source company

Our operating procedure provides for equal opportunities in recruitment and employment with the aim to eliminate discrimination against any job applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, sexual orientation, gender, religion or beliefs, marital or civil partnerships status, family or dependency status, disability, pregnancy and maternity or membership of a traveling community.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer Python & SQL
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced **Senior Machine Learning Engineer** to join an international technology project and build production-grade machine learning solutions for real estate and facilities management.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who has experience taking ML models from initial problem definition to production deployment and ongoing optimization. You will work on forecasting models, model evaluation, MLOps, data quality, and ML-powered services that support business decisions related to space, occupancy, headcount, rent, and financial planning.

### **About the Project**

You will join a global SaaS company specializing in real estate and facilities lifecycle management. Its cloud-based solutions help organizations manage real estate portfolios, lease administration, facilities maintenance, occupancy, energy management, workspace planning, and other related operations.

The project focuses on building reliable ML solutions that support complex business decisions through forecasting, predictive analytics, and data-driven insights.

### **Working Environment**

* International product and engineering teams.
* Full-time engagement.
* Remote cooperation within LATAM (Argentina, Brazil, or Mexico).
* Working hours: 8 AM – 5 PM CST.
* Project duration: 6+ months (to be confirmed).
* Own equipment required.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design, develop, deploy, and maintain production ML models, particularly forecasting solutions.
* Own the full ML lifecycle, including problem framing, feature engineering, training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
* Build and maintain model-serving APIs using technologies such as FastAPI and Pydantic.
* Develop robust model evaluation processes, including backtesting, validation, regression testing, and performance monitoring.
* Monitor production models for accuracy, data drift, performance degradation, and operational costs.
* Implement MLOps practices to ensure reproducible deployments, versioning, monitoring, and retraining.
* Contribute to embedding and retrieval systems and evaluate their quality using real customer documents.
* Support synthetic data generation and assess its quality, model performance, and privacy risks.
* Ensure model reliability, security, data privacy, and compliance with tenant-level access requirements.
* Collaborate with Product, Platform Engineering, Data Platform, and AI teams to integrate ML models into products and AI-powered workflows.
* Document technical solutions, communicate model behavior and uncertainty, and mentor other engineers.

### **Requirements**

* **5+ years of professional engineering experience**, with a strong background in Machine Learning.
* Proven experience taking at least one ML model from problem definition to production and maintaining it through monitoring and retraining.
* Strong proficiency in **Python and SQL**.
* Hands-on experience with ML libraries such as **scikit-learn, PyTorch, and pandas** or equivalent.
* Experience building production services using **FastAPI, Pydantic**, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of statistics, probability, and forecasting models, including prediction intervals and uncertainty estimation.
* Practical experience with ML evaluation, including backtesting, time-aware validation, holdout datasets, metric selection, calibration, and error analysis.
* Experience with **MLOps**, model serving, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
* Knowledge of CI/CD, automated testing, code review, and production engineering practices.
* Understanding of data leakage, data drift, distribution shift, bias, and privacy risks.
* Ability to explain model performance, limitations, and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders.
* Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with embeddings, retrieval systems, and retrieval quality evaluation.
* Knowledge of synthetic data generation, differential privacy, and privacy attack evaluation.
* Experience with geospatial or location-based data.
* Familiarity with LLM agents and frameworks such as LangGraph.
* Experience with Airflow, AWS Step Functions, or similar orchestration tools.
* Experience with Docker, model registries, experiment tracking, and self-hosted model inference.
* Background in real estate, facilities management, finance, or other data-intensive enterprise domains.

**Atribuições principais:**

Aderência ao Template Global (Fit-to-Standard): Conduzir workshops de Fit-to-Standard, demonstrando como os processos locais de serviços são atendidos pelo modelo padrão do SAP, desafiando requisitos que tentem replicar fluxos de sistemas legados.

Integração Cross-Módulo: Garantir a integração fluida entre o módulo de Serviços e áreas correlatas, especialmente SD (faturamento e contratos), MM (gestão de materiais/peças), PM/EAM (equipamentos e base instalada), CO (custos e rentabilidade de ordens de serviço) e Localização Brasil (emissão de NFS-e, remessa/retorno para conserto, substituição em garantia).

Postura Consultiva e Assertividade: Atuar como Trusted Advisor junto ao cliente, propondo soluções otimizadas, elaborando estimativas realistas e precisas, e atuando de forma proativa na prevenção e resolução de incidentes críticos.

Suporte ao CoE e Documentação: Elaborar especificações funcionais claras, apoiar testes integrados (SIT), testes de aceitação (UAT) e conduzir a transferência de conhecimento para a equipe local e o Center of Excellence (CoE).

**Requisitos:**

Experiência Sólida: Mínimo de 5 a 7 anos de experiência prática em implementação e suporte de SAP CS (Customer Service) e/ou SAP S/4HANA Service (desejável conhecimento em SAP Field Service Management - FSM).

Domínio de Processos: Forte vivência em gestão de Base Instalada (Installed Base / Equipamentos), Ordens de Serviço (SM01/SM02), Planos de Manutenção, Contratos de Serviço, Faturamento relacionado a recursos (RRB - Resource-Related Billing) e Gestão de Garantias.

Localização Brasil (Fiscal/Tributário): Conhecimento prático das regras fiscais brasileiras aplicadas a serviços e movimentação de peças (NFS-e, CFOPs de remessa/retorno de conserto, garantias e tributação de serviços).

Projetos Globais: Experiência prévia em projetos de rollout internacional ou com adoção de Template Global (comunicação ativa com equipes globai  
  
Idiomas: Inglês avançado/fluente para condução de reuniões técnicas, alinhamentos com arquitetura global e elaboração de documentação (imprescindível).

Experiência no setor industrial / manufatura de equipamentos (bens de capital, bombas, máquinas industriais com pós-venda técnico).

Conhecimento de integração com Variant Configuration (VC) na estrutura de equipamentos/materiais.

Certificação SAP em CS, S/4HANA Service ou PM/EAM.

Somos uma consultoria especializada em evolução digital. Mas, acima de tudo, somos uma empresa de gente. Gente que ouve antes de propor. Que vai ao essencial antes de apresentar solução. Que mede sucesso pelo que mudou de verdade, não pelo que foi implementado.

Tecnologia

jobs.description:
**None:**  
Na Senior, tecnologia é construída em times colaborativos, com autonomia, responsabilidade e foco em impacto real no negócio.
  
Você atua em soluções que evoluem continuamente, lidando com desafios concretos e participando das decisões que moldam produtos usados por milhares de empresas. Para impulsionar o ecossistema tech com a gente, conheça um pouco mais sobre o Manifesto de Tecnologia da Senior .
  
  
**SOBRE O DESAFIO:**  
Buscamos um(a) SecOps Infrastructure Analyst I para integrar nosso time de Segurança da Informação , atuando no monitoramento e na análise dos ambientes de infraestrutura, com foco na identificação de vulnerabilidades, ameaças e incidentes de segurança.
  
  
O profissional será responsável por contribuir para a proteção dos ativos da empresa, apoiando a identificação e tratamento de eventos de segurança e garantindo a integridade, segurança e disponibilidade dos ambientes.
  
  
A posição possui atuação híbrida , com oportunidade para Novo Hamburgo/RS .
  
  
**PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:**  
Instalar, atualizar e administrar os ambientes de infraestrutura do ERP (servidores, aplicação e serviços relacionados), em nuvem ou on-premises.
  
Monitorar o ambiente para garantir disponibilidade e desempenho, e atuar na resolução de problemas e incidentes.
  
**Aplicar boas práticas de segurança:** configuração segura (hardening) dos servidores, controle de acessos e correção de vulnerabilidades.
  
Analisar logs e eventos para identificar falhas, lentidões e comportamentos suspeitos.
  
**Apoiar a administração dos bancos de dados do ERP:** instalação, backup, restauração e ajustes de desempenho.
  
Trabalhar junto com as equipes de suporte, desenvolvimento e clientes em implantações, migrações e atendimentos.
  
Documentar procedimentos, configurações e mudanças feitas nos ambientes.
  
Seguir as políticas de segurança da empresa e as normas aplicáveis, como a LGPD.
  
  
**O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:**  
**Experiência Profissional:** Pelo menos 2 anos em funções relacionadas a análise de infraestrutura de segurança, com foco em SecOps ou operações de TI.
  
**Habilidades Técnicas:** Conhecimento sólido em redes (TCP/IP, VLANs), ferramentas de monitoramento (ex.: zabbix, grafana), scripting (Python ou Bash) e conceitos de cibersegurança; familiaridade com ambientes on-premise e cloud (ex.: OCI - infraestrutura de servidores e banco de dados ou Azure - DNS e WAF).
  
  
**O QUE PODE POTENCIALIZAR SUA CANDIDATURA:**  
Conhecimento em banco de dados, principalmente Oracle e SQL Server.
  
Experiência com nuvem, principalmente OCI (Oracle Cloud) e Azure, incluindo segurança em nuvem.
  
Experiência com ferramentas de segurança e monitoramento, como SIEM e IDS/IPS.
  
Automação e infraestrutura como código (Ansible, Terraform).
  
Containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  
Conhecimento de normas e frameworks de segurança (ISO 27001, NIST).
  
Certificações em segurança ou nuvem (por exemplo, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft Azure, OCI).
  
Inglês técnico, nível intermediário ou avançado.

Convênio Médico e Odontológico;
  
Seguro de Vida;
  
PPLR - Participação nos lucros e resultados;
  
Cartão Wiipo com benefícios flexíveis;
  
Clube Wiipo com descontos e vantagens exclusivas;
  
TotalPass - Benefício de academias e bem-estar;
  
OnHappy - Benefício de vantagens para viagens;
  
Banco de horas;
  
**Empresa cidadã:** Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  
Assistência natalidade;
  
Assistência PET;
  
Universidade Corporativa Senior;
  
Plano de desenvolvimento de carreira.

Nossa cultura respeita as individualidades e potencializa as pessoas com inovação, colaboração e autonomia. Estas informações são específicas para esta oportunidade, mas você pode conferir todas as nossas vagas e ainda mais sobre como é ser Senior na nossa página de carreiras: senior.com.br/carreiras

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer ID92207
jobs.description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a **Data Platform Engineer** to operate, stabilize, and continuously improve an enterprise data platform supporting analytics and reporting in a regulated healthcare environment.

The mandatory requirements are 5+ years in Data Engineering, Snowflake, SQL, dbt, Fivetran or HVR, AWS S3, Python, data quality, observability, incident management, mentoring, and upper-intermediate English, with Central Time availability and on-call rotation. Argo Workflows or Airflow is a plus.

**What you will do**

* Provide senior technical ownership for the Data Platform service tower during the LatAm coverage window, including day-to-day operations, complex troubleshooting, and L2/L3 escalation.
* Operate and improve **Snowflake** production and non-production environments, including warehouse configuration and sizing, performance and consumption monitoring, object lifecycle, environment hygiene, and support for production changes.
* Administer data access within established controls, including users, roles, service accounts, secrets, and credential rotation, while maintaining least-privilege and audit-ready practices.
* Operate and improve data ingestion across Fivetran, HVR where applicable, and custom pipelines, including connector configuration, scheduling, source onboarding, schema-change coordination, failure recovery, backfills, and dependency management.
* Design, build, and maintain reliable pipelines and **dbt** models across RAW, CURATED, and CONSUMPTION layers, with appropriate testing, documentation, lineage, version control, and CI/CD practices.
* Support **AWS S3** data-lake operations, including raw and landing-zone workflows, lifecycle and retention controls, access patterns, logging, ingestion failures, and coordination with downstream Snowflake workloads.
* Support Argo Workflows and Kubernetes-hosted data workloads in close coordination with the Cloud / DevOps team, including scheduling, troubleshooting, deployment, recovery, and capacity dependencies.
* Define and improve data quality and observability standards, including freshness, zero-row, row-count growth, null, duplicate, schema-drift, and referential-integrity checks.
* Expand end-to-end monitoring and lineage using tools such as SYNQ, dbt, Snowflake audit data, Splunk, and the agreed alerting stack, linking actionable alerts to evidence and runbooks.
* Lead or support major data incidents, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and preventive actions across ingestion, orchestration, Snowflake, and downstream Tableau dependencies.
* Support Tableau Cloud operations where upstream data, connectivity, permissions, extracts, or refresh failures require Data Platform investigation.
* Identify and deliver standardization, automation, reliability, performance, and cost improvements, including migration of suitable legacy or custom extraction patterns toward agreed golden paths.
* Execute work through controlled incident, request, access, change, and release processes using iRhythm's service-management workflows.
* Create and maintain runbooks, operating procedures, architecture context, ownership information, recovery procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Mentor Middle-level engineers, review technical work, improve team practices, and ensure effective handoffs across the distributed service team.
* Participate in the Data Platform on-call rotation for critical incidents outside staffed service hours.

**Must haves**

* **5+ years of professional experience** in Data Engineering or Data Platform Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience operating and developing solutions on **Snowflake**, including data-layer design, warehouse performance, access patterns, and production troubleshooting.
* Advanced **SQL** skills and strong experience with **dbt** for transformation, testing, documentation, lineage, and controlled deployment.
* Experience operating managed ingestion tools such as **Fivetran or HVR** and supporting custom data-ingestion pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with **AWS data services**, particularly **S3** and event-driven or file-based ingestion patterns.
* Proficiency in **Python** or a comparable language for data engineering, automation, and operational tooling.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, pipeline dependencies, schema evolution, backfills, data validation, and production data quality.
* Experience with observability, logging, alerting, and incident-management practices for production data platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex incident resolution, perform root-cause analysis, and convert findings into preventive improvements.
* Ability to make well-reasoned technical decisions, identify tradeoffs, estimate work, and guide improvements across a complex platform.
* Experience mentoring engineers and collaborating effectively with Cloud / DevOps, Analytics, Security, Governance, and business stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to work directly with client stakeholders.
* Availability to work from **9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Central Time** and participate in an agreed on-call rotation, including assisting with critical incidents outside normal hours when needed.
* Upper-intermediate English level.

**Nice to haves**

* Experience orchestrating and troubleshooting data workloads with **Argo Workflows or Airflow on Kubernetes**, or comparable workflow-orchestration technologies.
* Hands-on experience with data-specific observability platform.
* Experience supporting Tableau Cloud administration, data-source connectivity, extracts, scheduled refreshes, or production dashboard dependencies.
* Familiarity with Snowflake cost optimization, audit logging, tasks, stored procedures, and environment rationalization.
* Experience migrating legacy ingestion or orchestration patterns such as Boomi or AWS Data Pipeline to modern managed or Kubernetes-based solutions.
* Experience with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code practices supporting data platforms.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE:**

Quartile, the world's largest retail media optimization platform, is a trusted partner for multichannel e-commerce success. Through unmatched expertise and patented AI technology, we fuel growth for 5,300+ brands and sellers worldwide and manage an annual ad spend exceeding $2 billion. The award-winning platform covers major marketplaces and ad channels for optimal reach. The result is unprecedented granularity, smarter budgeting, and bespoke solutions for retailers.

Quartile is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with employees stemming from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. As a business, we value the enrichment that diversity brings to our organization and are committed to a culture that creates a sense of inclusion and belonging. We welcome new perspectives and affirm that all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, familial or marital status, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

**About Sciene**  
At Sciene, the mission is to empower professional services firms with cutting-edge, customized AI solutions — enhancing automation, analytics, and optimization across industries while prioritizing security, cost efficiency, and state-of-the-art technology.  
Our flagship product, the **Sciene AI Companion**, is an autonomous customer success platform deployed across Quartile — the world's largest retail media optimization platform, managing performance marketing for 1,000+ brands. It automates relationship-heavy enterprise workflows end to end: generating personalized email replies in the CSM's own voice (8x faster), building full presentation decks for client meetings (12x faster), and detecting and diagnosing account fluctuations before anyone has to ask (6x faster). None of this replaces human judgment — it removes the work that was getting in the way of it.  
Read more about how we built it: Sciene AI Companion: Building an Autonomous Customer Success Platform on Databricks  
  
**OVERVIEW:**

The AI Companion’s agents write the email drafts and the meeting decks. Everything around them runs on our backend: Outlook mailboxes and calendars synced in near real time, the queues that trigger every draft, the permissions that decide who sees which client, and the APIs behind every screen of the Sciene portal. That backend is a TypeScript / Node.js monorepo on Azure, used every day by hundreds of Quartile CSMs.

The Senior Backend Engineer owns production services end to end. You design the API and the data model, write the migration, wire the queue consumer, instrument it, and watch it in Grafana after the deploy. The platform is now past its first build: we are moving operational data from MongoDB (Cosmos DB vCore) to Postgres on Databricks Lakebase, running more of the product on event-driven flows (Graph webhooks, Service Bus, Event Hubs), and putting tight latency and cost budgets on the hot paths. That work needs senior judgment more than extra hands.

This is also a role where you work with AI, not just for it. Our engineers ship with coding agents (Claude Code and our MCP-integrated toolchain) as part of the normal workflow. Many of your API consumers are LLM agents themselves — which raises the bar on contracts, idempotency, and latency.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* 5+ years building and operating backend systems in production, at least 3 of them with Node.js and TypeScript — including a solid grasp of the event loop, async I/O, and the advanced type system.
* Deep experience designing REST APIs with a modern framework (Fastify, Express, or NestJS): routing, validation with schemas (Zod or similar), authentication and authorization, versioning, and clear error contracts — secure by default (OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, OWASP Top 10, tenant isolation in a multi-tenant system).
* Strong data modeling in both relational (PostgreSQL) and document (MongoDB) databases, and the judgment to choose between them: indexes, query plans, transactions, migrations on live data, and an ORM such as Prisma without hiding behind it.
* Hands-on experience with asynchronous and event-driven architecture: message queues or event streams, idempotent consumers, retries and dead-letter queues, scheduled jobs, and webhooks.
* Experience integrating third-party APIs at scale, with the operational maturity that implies (OAuth and token refresh, pagination, throttling, partial failure, backfills).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (we run on Azure — App Service, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Entra ID) and containerized deployment with Docker.
* Testing as a habit: unit and integration tests against real dependencies, and confidence that a green CI means the feature works.
* Observability in production: tracing, metrics, and structured logs (OpenTelemetry or equivalent), and the discipline to debug from evidence rather than guesses.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and zero-downtime release practices, plus solid git and code-review habits.
* Practical experience using AI coding assistants/agents in real engineering work, and the critical eye to know when their output is wrong.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, and the autonomy expected of a senior engineer: you own a problem end to end — from framing to shipped, monitored outcome — and are accountable for the result, not just the merge.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.
* Professional working proficiency in English (written specs, code review).

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Microsoft Graph and the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Outlook mail and calendar, change notifications, MSAL).
* Databricks (Lakebase/Postgres, SQL warehouses, synced tables) or another lakehouse feeding an operational app.
* Experience migrating a live system between databases (e.g. MongoDB/Cosmos DB to PostgreSQL) without downtime.
* Experience building backends for LLM-powered products: streaming responses (SSE/WebSockets), long-running jobs, cost and latency budgets, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Observability stacks: OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Loki, structured logging.
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Azure networking/identity.
* Comfort working on the frontend when a feature needs it (React, TypeScript, TanStack Query).
* Domain background in retail media, digital advertising, CRM, or B2B SaaS.
* Track record of shipping something from 0 to 1 in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift often.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**
